NON_PAPILLARY.Solid Urothelial Tumor Nests: Cohesive malignant urothelial groups form solid islands or broad sheets with irregular outlines in the surrounding tissue.
NON_PAPILLARY.Infiltrative Cords and Small Groups: Narrow malignant epithelial cords and detached small tumor groups extend through stromal tissue at irregular interfaces.
NON_PAPILLARY.Reactive Stroma Around Tumor Islands: Fibrous stromal compartments surround malignant epithelial islands and separate neighboring solid tumor regions.
NON_PAPILLARY.Heterogeneous Solid Tumor Compartments: Solid tumor areas show variable cellular density and may contain focal necrotic regions beside viable malignant epithelium.
NON_PAPILLARY.Solid Urothelial Tumor Nests / Cohesive: Closely apposed polygonal tumor cells form compact epithelial aggregates within a solid urothelial nest.
NON_PAPILLARY.Solid Urothelial Tumor Nests / Disordere: Tumor cells within solid nests have uneven orientation and irregular spacing rather than orderly epithelial layering.
NON_PAPILLARY.Solid Urothelial Tumor Nests / Uneven Ne: The outer contours of malignant epithelial islands are irregular and may contain small projecting cell groups.
NON_PAPILLARY.Infiltrative Cords and Small Groups / Th: Short strands of atypical urothelial cells track between stromal collagen bundles.
NON_PAPILLARY.Infiltrative Cords and Small Groups / De: Small malignant epithelial clusters are separated from larger tumor nests by intervening connective tissue.
NON_PAPILLARY.Infiltrative Cords and Small Groups / An: Irregularly shaped epithelial groups form sharply contoured profiles where tumor interdigitates with stroma.
NON_PAPILLARY.Reactive Stroma Around Tumor Islands / P: Eosinophilic collagen fibers border and partition cohesive malignant urothelial groups.
NON_PAPILLARY.Reactive Stroma Around Tumor Islands / I: Spindle-shaped fibroblastic cells lie in connective tissue immediately adjacent to infiltrative tumor islands.
Variable inflammatory cells are interspersed within the stroma around malignant epithelial nests.
NON_PAPILLARY.Heterogeneous Solid Tumor Compartments /: Cell-dense epithelial areas alternate with less compact malignant groups within a solid tumor compartment.
Localized eosinophilic debris and fragmented nuclei occur within some solid malignant epithelial regions.
Atypical urothelial cells border focal necrotic material within an otherwise viable solid tumor area.

PAPILLARY.Branching Papillary Fronds: Exophytic epithelial projections form branching papillary structures supported by recognizable connective tissue cores.
PAPILLARY.Fibrovascular Papillary Cores: Connective tissue stalks containing small vessels support malignant urothelial layers within the papillary projections.
PAPILLARY.Atypical Urothelial Lining: Multilayered tumor epithelium covers papillary cores with variable thickness and disturbance of normal urothelial organization.
PAPILLARY.Complex and Fused Papillary Structures: Adjacent papillary projections may become crowded, broadened, or fused while retaining portions of their supporting stromal framework.
PAPILLARY.Branching Papillary Fronds / Fingerlike: Elongated epithelial fronds extend around stromal cores and project into spaces between adjacent papillae.
PAPILLARY.Branching Papillary Fronds / Secondary P: Smaller epithelial-lined projections emerge from larger papillary stalks, creating a branched architecture.
PAPILLARY.Branching Papillary Fronds / Interpapill: Open spaces separate neighboring epithelial-lined fronds and delineate their external papillary contours.
PAPILLARY.Fibrovascular Papillary Cores / Core Cap: Small vascular channels containing erythrocytes are visible within the connective tissue center of papillary stalks.
PAPILLARY.Fibrovascular Papillary Cores / Collagen: Fine collagen fibers and spindle-shaped stromal cells form the supporting tissue beneath papillary epithelium.
PAPILLARY.Fibrovascular Papillary Cores / Epitheli: Malignant urothelial layers lie along a recognizable interface with the underlying fibrovascular stalk.
PAPILLARY.Atypical Urothelial Lining / Uneven Epit: The number and arrangement of urothelial cell layers vary along individual papillary fronds.
PAPILLARY.Atypical Urothelial Lining / Disordered: Nuclei within the papillary lining show irregular orientation and variable crowding relative to the stromal core.
PAPILLARY.Atypical Urothelial Lining / Surface Mat: The epithelial surface shows variable loss of orderly maturation and irregular contours of superficial tumor cells.
PAPILLARY.Complex and Fused Papillary Structures /: Closely spaced epithelial-lined projections create complex contours with narrow intervening spaces.
Tumor epithelium joins neighboring papillary projections, producing irregular bridges between their outlines.
Small fibrovascular stromal profiles remain identifiable within broadened or partially fused papillary tumor structures.
